title: Case Study Template
subtitle: A reference showing every available section type — copy this file to start a new case study

hero.alt: Placeholder hero — replace with your own

sections.title: TEXT — free-form prose with lists and subsections
paragraphs: A plain text section. Use paragraphs for body copy and inline HTML is allowed.
Add as many paragraphs as you need.

lists.intro: An optional list with an intro line:

subsections.title: A subsection heading
paragraphs: Subsections nest an h3 with their own paragraphs and lists.

sections.label: Challenge
sections.headline: CHALLENGE — the core problem in one line.
sections.subheading: Icon cards with a short line each:

cards.text: Card one. icon = any key from the icon set.

sections.label: Users / Principles
sections.headline: PRINCIPLES — icon cards with a title + description.
sections.subheading: Like challenge cards, but with titles

sections.label: Problems
sections.headline: PROBLEMS — numbered problems, each with an optional quote.

problems.title: Problem one
problems.description: Describe the problem and its impact.

problems.title: Problem two
problems.description: This one omits the quote — quote is optional.

sections.label: Insights
sections.headline: INSIGHTS — numbered research findings, plus optional competitive block.

sections.title: FEATURES — alternating feature blocks with media

features.name: Feature one
features.headline: Punchy headline for the feature.
features.description: Explain the feature. Bold key phrases. Media can be image or video.

features.name: Feature two
features.headline: Second feature with a video.
features.description: Videos autoplay muted in a loop.

sections.title: MEDIA — a single standalone image or video
sections.intro: Optional intro line above the media.

sections.label: Gallery
sections.headline: IMAGES-GRID — a responsive grid of images.

sections.title: HIGHLIGHT — a simple emphasized bullet list
OUTCOMES-LIST — a plain bullet list of outcomes
Iterations
sections.headline: ITERATIONS — icon items showing what changed.

subsections.title: What I'd do differently
paragraphs: A subsection can use paragraphs instead of icon items.

sections.title: Conclusion
sections.headline: CONCLUSION — wrap-up paragraphs.
paragraphs: Summarize the impact and what it meant.
